name: Article 3, after § 3 – 66
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Public interface connected to the Internal Market Information System for the declaration of posting of workers and amending Regulation (EU) No 1024/2012
part_text: 3a. Member States making use of the public interface shall ensure that service providers are able to correct or update a posting declaration through the public interface at any time. Where a service provider corrects or updates a posting declaration before it has been notified of an inspection or of a request for information concerning that posting, the correction or update shall not in itself give rise to a penalty, and the logging of user activity referred to in Article 2(1), point (b), shall not be used for that purpose. Penalties for infringements of the obligation to declare the posting of workers shall take into account the good faith of the service provider and shall not be imposed cumulatively for each posted worker without an upper limit.
